# dr_flac

`dr_flac.h` decodes FLAC uploads (`audio_data` on `/cover`, `/continue` and
`/transcribe`). Encoding is yuey's own, in `tools/server/flac.cpp`.

- Source: https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs
- Release: `flac-0.13.3` (dr_flac v0.13.3, 2026-01-17), commit
  `69d777c482775858e8ea8a7b047c9bcd451febc8`
- SHA-256: `a35468f278f17cf9538ce189debf76a5854a77e139980f7b5185d67566a0c837`
